description: This file defines the ConsoleAPI class for interacting with a browser's console, providing methods to query and manipulate DOM elements via injected scripts, including locator utilities and aria snapshot functionality.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: A utility class for constructing and filtering DOM element locators with various selector options.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the Playwright-related functions into the window object if not already present.

methods.name: _querySelector
methods.description: Queries a single DOM element based on a selector string with strictness option.

methods.name: _querySelectorAll
methods.description: Queries all DOM elements matching a selector string.

methods.name: _inspect
methods.description: Inspects a DOM element in the console.

methods.name: _selector
methods.description: Generates a selector string for a given DOM element.

methods.name: _generateLocator
methods.description: Creates a locator object for a DOM element with optional language parameter.

methods.name: _resume
methods.description: Resumes execution if a resume function is available in the window object.
